# Blocksphere

> Enterprise blockchain consulting and development — bridging boardroom ambition with production-grade decentralization across Indonesia and beyond.

Blocksphere is PT Blocksphere Teknoniaga Indonesia, an enterprise blockchain consulting and development company shipping production systems since 2017.

## Portfolio

- [Interactive portfolio](https://portfolio.blocksphere.id/): The visual, searchable Blocksphere project portfolio.
- [Complete text portfolio](https://portfolio.blocksphere.id/portfolio.md): Company information, detailed featured work, and the full public project archive.
- [Full LLM context](https://portfolio.blocksphere.id/llms-full.txt): The complete portfolio as plain text.
- [Portfolio JSON](https://portfolio.blocksphere.id/portfolio.json): Structured company, client, featured-project, and archive data.
- [Sitemap](https://portfolio.blocksphere.id/sitemap.xml): Canonical machine-readable endpoints.
